SELECT a.id, a.uuid::text AS uuid, a.title, a.slug, a.summary, u.nickname AS authorNickname, a.view_count AS viewCount, a.like_count AS likeCount, a.published_at AS publishedAt FROM articles a JOIN users u ON a.author_id = u.id WHERE a.uuid IN
#{uuid}::uuid
AND a.status = 'PUBLISHED'

SELECT at.article_id::text AS articleUuid, t.name AS tagName FROM article_tags at JOIN tags t ON at.tag_id = t.id WHERE at.article_id IN
#{articleUuid}::uuid
ORDER BY at.article_id, t.name
